title: Home Delivery Coordination Note: Delivery Extension of the Retail Review Bridge
content:
**Coordination rule.** For an emergency supply under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit, the delivery extension of the bridge depends on the member's Home Delivery Pharmacy:

- when a prescription for the drug is on file at the Home Delivery Pharmacy and the home delivery account is active, it is 5 days;
- when a prescription for the drug is on file there and the account is on hold, it is 12 days;
- otherwise it is zero days.

## What is read

| Record | Where it is read |
|---|---|
| A prescription for the drug on file | The prescriptions on file with the member's Home Delivery Pharmacy account |
| Account status (active or on hold) | The member's Home Delivery Pharmacy account |

## Combinations

| Prescription for the drug on file at home delivery | Home delivery account status | Delivery extension |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Active | 5 days |
| Yes | On hold | 12 days |
| Yes | Any other status | 0 days |
| No | Any status | 0 days |
| No home delivery account | — | 0 days |

## Examples (hypothetical members)

- A member's Home Delivery Pharmacy account is on hold and holds a prescription for Eliquis; the bridge is for Eliquis: 12 days.
- The same account is active again: 5 days.
- The account is active but holds prescriptions only for other drugs: 0 days.
